name: SwitchYard.offline
description: SwitchYard.offline - a local, content-blind LLM router. A CPCP wrapper around NVIDIA SwitchYard's passthrough/random/stage_router features, running entirely on your device. Your keys and prompts never leave your machine.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; connect-src https://api.openai.com https://api.anthropic.com https://integrate.api.nvidia.com; object-src 'none'
